note: RV resort at 500 Coleto Park Rd, about 12 miles SW of Victoria near Coleto Creek Reservoir: full-hookup back-in and pull-through sites, cabins and tent sites; pool, ten private bathhouses, playground, clubhouse, fenced dog park, WiFi, laundry, nature trails, a catch-and-release fishing pond, and an on-site café Wednesday to Saturday evenings. Weekend and long-term guests. Books online. --Claude
Small campground on WA-410 along the Naches River, about 16 miles NW of Naches toward Chinook Pass: 20 water/electric RV sites among the pines, plus tent sites. Books through ResNexus. --Claude

Large campground on Lac Saint-Mathieu at Saint-Mathieu-de-Rioux, south of Trois-Pistoles: deluxe and regular RV sites (mostly pull-through, five services), tent sites, cabins and chalets, and a big seasonal section. Pool, mini golf, playgrounds, beach and lake access, activities all season. --Claude

Family campground at 6955 OH-101 near Clyde, in Seneca County: back-in water/electric sites, full-hookup pull-throughs and back-ins, buddy sites, tent sites, cabins and rental campers, plus seasonal sites. Swimming pond with a sand beach, fishing, camp store, live music on summer weekends. Open April to October. --Claude

Wooded family campground at 307 Pioneer Trail, Muncy Valley, near Eagles Mere and Worlds End State Park: water/electric (30 or 50 amp) and electric-only sites, one full-hookup site, tent and primitive sites, rustic cabins and furnished cottages. Store, laundry, activity center, pavilion, ball field, hiking trail, dump station. Monthly and seasonal sites by phone. --Claude

Large RV campground at 31635 SE Ashworth Rd, Waukee, just west of Des Moines: full-hookup and water/electric sites (20/30/50 amp, pull-throughs), furnished cabins and tent sites; open all year. Sister park Timberline East is at Newton. --Claude
